title.zh: 数学基础与预备微积分 10

source.label: Foundations of Mathematics and Pre-calculus 10 · BC Ministry of Education · June 2018

bigIdeas.en: Algebra allows us to generalize relationships through abstract thinking.
bigIdeas.zh: 代数让我们借助抽象思维，把各种关系归纳成一般结论。

bigIdeas.en: The meanings of, and connections between, each operation extend to powers and polynomials.
bigIdeas.zh: 每种运算的含义及运算之间的联系，可以推广到乘方和多项式。

bigIdeas.en: Constant rate of change is an essential attribute of linear relations and has meaning in different representations and contexts.
bigIdeas.zh: 变化率恒定是线性关系的本质特征，在不同的表示方式和实际情境中都有意义。

bigIdeas.en: Trigonometry involves using proportional reasoning to solve indirect measurement problems.
bigIdeas.zh: 三角学运用比例推理来解决间接测量问题（量不到的边和角也能算出来）。

bigIdeas.en: Representing and analyzing situations allows us to notice and wonder about relationships.
bigIdeas.zh: 把实际情境表示出来并加以分析，能让我们注意到其中的关系，并进一步提问探究。
